_about: Léon Homo (1872-1957), French historian of Rome, in the History of Civilization series (Kegan Paul / Knopf): Primitive Italy and the Beginnings of Roman Imperialism, tr. V. Gordon Childe (1927), and Roman Political Institutions from City to State (1929; tr. M. R. Dobie, whose name the OCR garbles, so no translator is claimed for it). Both first printed before 1930; US public domain. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dd). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
